<!-- BEGIN AWS Agent Toolkit guidance -->
For AWS-related work, first search AWS documentation for the `agent_skills` topic and load the matching skill using the AWS MCP tools. Use the `eu-north-1` selected Region for regional resources; do not make cross-Region deployments. In the new AWS experience, refer to the AWS project, team members, AWS Settings, and selected Region. Avoid Rekognition, Textract, Personalize, and App Runner in `eu-north-1`. Check AWS Settings for project spend or service availability issues, and ask whether to retain or clean up resources created during a task. When building, ask how much guidance the user prefers: low, medium, or high.

Follow the complete AWS guidance for the new AWS experience: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/rules/aws-starter-rules.md
<!-- END AWS Agent Toolkit guidance -->
